time.evaluation_time: Explicit UTC input; never read ambient now for deterministic evaluation
time.receipt_expiry: evaluation_time + 86400 seconds; prototype test-policy choice, not operational freshness authority
time.fresh_capture_rule: Both capture timestamps required; start <= finish <= evaluation_time; evaluation_time - finish <= fresh_max_age_seconds
time.historical_missing_time: Preserve null and freshness unknown; may support historical integrity, cannot support fresh claim

not_evaluable_import: Choose state by recorded causal facts; if insufficient, inconclusive. Keep original label and cause.
runtime_unknown: Expected unknown can satisfy a fault assertion; preserve unknown runtime outcome in receipt.

aggregation.duplicate_or_out_of_range_slot: invalid campaign; retain offending records as findings and do not silently choose one
aggregation.missing_slot: emit missing receipt for required slot
aggregation.pass: Every required slot passed under selected claim mode and binding valid
aggregation.retain: All individual states and findings even when campaign state has higher precedence

determinism: Same exact bytes, policy and evaluation_time produce same canonical receipt bytes; sort object keys and assertion slots; arrays preserving source order remain ordered.
invalidation: Digest a canonical sorted list of role/ref/version/sha256, including policy. Do not change old bindings to repair drift.
